free_tier.stated: SRP-1 at EUR 3.99/month: 1 GB RAM, 1 vCore, 20 GB storage, 5 TB bandwidth, printed by the vendor's own store group (Cloud VPS - Shared Regular Performance) with order links per billing cycle. This matches the tracker row's shape and price; the tracker row already in evidence remains the only source for the port speed, the location and custom ISO support. The next vendor tiers are SRP-2 EUR 9.99 (2 GB, 40 GB, 10 TB), SRP-3 EUR 19.99 (4 GB, 80 GB, 10 TB), SRP-4 EUR 39.99 (8 GB, 160 GB, 20 TB), SRP-5 EUR 79.99 (16 GB, 240 GB, 20 TB) and SRP-6 EUR 149.99 (32 GB, 480 GB, 20 TB).
